alignments.note: Superscription 'A Psalm' answers to no morpheme; one added unit (rule 2).
Single imperative realized twice; the italic second 'bless' over the gapped colon is the same verb's discontinuous unit (rule 34/25).
Noun 'inward parts' recast as relative clause 'that is within' (rule 46 closing paragraph); relative and copula join the noun's unit, headed on 'within'.

review_notes: Second 'bless' read as distributed realization of the one imperative rather than added.

alignments.note: Substantival article on participle takes the relative 'Who' (rule 41).
Dative lamed silenced; object promoted to direct object (rule 40).
Margin 'Or, the pit' read and set aside (rule 38).
'tender mercies' for one noun; headed on 'mercies', the ASV's ordinary word for the lexeme (rule 31); heading on 'tender' was the alternative.
Substantival adjective with supplied generic 'things' (rule 46), headed on 'good'.
ASV 'desire' for 'ornament'; margin notes the Hebrew, printed text governs (rule 38).
Supplied result subordinator 'So that' for an asyndetic clause (rule 55).
'righteous acts' for one noun; 'acts' is the supplied generic (rule 31).
Anarthrous passive participle takes supplied 'that are' (rule 46).
Light verb 'made known' heads on complement 'known' (rule 44).
Preposition + noun rendered by one adverb 'always'; fused, headed on the noun (rule 40).
Waw + lo → 'Neither', headed on the negative (rule 35).
Supplied object noun and its possessive answer to no morpheme (rules 44, 18); one added unit.
Apodosis 'So' with no waw in the clause (rule 14).
Finite verb 'prevails' rendered 'great is'; headed on the lexical word.
Comparative kaph rendered by the English degree frame 'As ... as'; both words to the one preposition, discontinuous (rules 24, 25). Marking the second 'as' added was the alternative.
Hiphil 'made far' rendered 'far hath he removed'; 'far' writes the causative lexeme and stays with the verb.
Compound rendering 'Like as' for the one comparative; headed on 'as', 'Like' was the alternative head.
'pitieth his children' promotes the object; al silenced (rule 40).
Supplied possessive with no suffix present (rule 18).

Explicit הוּא realized twice: 'he' in its own clause and the resumed 'He' of the following participial (verbless) clause, which writes no subject of its own (rule 25); one discontinuous unit headed on the first occurrence. Giving the second 'He' to the participle under rule 17 was the alternative, but that permission reaches a finite verb's own person and number, and a participle predicate takes only the copula.
Passive participle זָכוּר as predicate → 'remembereth'; its subject pronoun is the resumed הוּא (rule 25).
Nominal predicate takes the construction copula (rule 20).
Explicit subject pronoun takes only its own 'we' (rule 20).

review_notes: Corrected: the resumed 'He' of the participial clause belongs to the earlier explicit הוּא (rule 25), not to the participle.

alignments.note: 'As for' before a fronted bare noun with no marker or preposition (rule 16).
Existential 'it is not' rendered 'is gone'; 'gone' carries the negation (rule 50); suffix takes the referential 'it'.
lo ... od → 'no ... more'; each takes its own word (rule 2).
No connective written for the waw of the range (rules 14, 26).
Vocative takes supplied 'ye', written before the noun (rule 36).
Articleless attributive recast as relative clause keeps 'That are' (rule 41).
Infinitive rendered as bare participle 'Hearkening'; no word for the lamed (rules 52, 40).
Vocative 'ye' written before the noun goes to it (rule 36).
